item.text: The app’s existing example fetches independent resources with `Promise.all` in an async server component. I’ll use that parallel pattern, resolve the same-origin API URLs from the incoming request (server-side fetch needs absolute URLs in Next), and show each response or its own error so one unavailable endpoint doesn’t hide the others.

Updated [Dashboard.tsx](/workspace/app/Dashboard.tsx) to fetch analytics, notifications, and settings in parallel using `Promise.all`. It resolves same-origin API URLs from the incoming request, displays each response as formatted JSON, and shows an endpoint-specific error if a request fails.

I didn’t run tests or a build.
